item.title: Extract backlog read commands to cmd-backlog-read module
item.intent: Extract cmd_backlog (dispatcher), cmd_backlog_check, _backlog_check_all, cmd_backlog_list, cmd_backlog_show, cmd_backlog_history, cmd_backlog_rm to .aishore/lib/cmd-backlog-read.sh — lazy-loaded, ~260 lines removed from main, dispatch updated, bash -n passes on both files.
steps: Identify all backlog read/check functions in .aishore/aishore (cmd_backlog, cmd_backlog_check, _backlog_check_all, cmd_backlog_list, cmd_backlog_show, cmd_backlog_history, cmd_backlog_rm)
Create .aishore/lib/cmd-backlog-read.sh with all identified functions, following the same module header pattern as existing modules
Update dispatch table in main to _load_module cmd-backlog-read before any backlog subcommand invocation — verify cmd-backlog-write is still loaded separately for write commands
Run bash -n on both files to verify syntax
Run .aishore/aishore backlog list, backlog show, backlog check --all, backlog history, backlog rm --help to verify output is unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: .aishore/aishore backlog show and backlog history work correctly
wc -l .aishore/aishore shows at least 230 fewer lines than before this change
